inlines.v: EVOLVE, verb transitive evolv'. [Latin evolvo; e and volvo, to roll; Eng. to wallow.] 1. To unfold; to open and expand. The animal soul sooner evolves itself to its full orb and extent than the human soul. 2. To throw out; to emit. EVOLVE, verb intransitive To open itself; to disclose itself.
